Several Wells Fargo branches in South Carolina changing hours

By mikem@thecolumbiastar.com
on March 24, 2020

FacebookTwitterEmailMessengerCopy LinkMessageShare

For the most up-to-date information, customers can check Wells Fargo’s website for ATM locations, status of branches

 

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:04
Instaread

March 24, 2020 – Wells Fargo continues to evaluate the steps necessary to ensure it can best serve customers, protect team members and minimize the spread of COVID-19.

Wells Fargo has adjusted standard branch operating hours across the nation. Branches will be open from 9:30 a.m. – 4 p.m., Monday through Friday. Branches with Saturday hours will be open from 9 a.m. – noon.

For the most up-to-date information, customers can check Wells Fargo’s branch locator for ATM locations and the status of branches. Many branches are offering drive-up services with lobbies open for appointments only.

Customers can also bank with us from almost anywhere 24 hours a day, 7 days a week using our online and mobile banking features, which include depositing checks, paying bills, transferring money, setting and receiving alerts, and sending and receiving money through Zelle®.

For more information on what Wells Fargo is doing to help its customers and other information, please visit https://www.wellsfargo.com/jump/enterprise/coronavirus-response.
